title: Specification-only consolidation emits verified and consolidated results
evidence: Missing evaluator sets verified=True (561-563), and consolidated derives solely from verified_count (619). main_dispatcher.py:807-832 passes None unless --execute and serializes these fields; JSON lacks a mode field.
trigger: Call execute_consolidation without a gate evaluator, or the CLI consolidate21 JSON path without --execute.
impact: Consumers receive 21 verified outcomes and consolidated=true without running gates. This is a misleading evidence receipt, not evidence of a runtime authorization bypass.

title: Timed-out consolidation gate subprocesses are left running
evidence: create_subprocess_shell at 638 and wait_for(proc.communicate()) at 644-647 are followed by timeout return at 652-653, with no terminate/kill/wait cleanup.
trigger: A gate exceeds timeout_s; cmd_consolidate21 --execute supplies this evaluator (main_dispatcher.py:807-812).
impact: The gate and shell descendants can continue consuming resources and writing output after the topology reports timeout, overlapping later work.

title: Canonical seal digest changes with optional dependency installation
evidence: _canonical_blake3_hex returns BLAKE3 when import succeeds (35-37), otherwise prefixed SHA-256 (38-39). Both flow into identical receipt fields without an algorithm identifier.
trigger: Replay the same logical tick and outcomes in environments with and without blake3.
impact: Identical causal data yields incompatible evidence, squad and Merkle digests despite the deterministic canonical receipt contract.

title: Stack slots grow beyond the reserved 256-byte frame
evidence: The prologue reserves 256 bytes. get_offset starts at 16 and increments by 8 without a bound or frame sizing pass; Alloc and Free emit calls.
trigger: Compile a block containing at least 32 distinct registers followed by Alloc or Free.
impact: The 32nd slot is rbp-264, exactly where call pushes its return address when rsp=rbp-256; slots collide with call data and program values are corrupted. More registers write below the frame.

title: Backend compile retains output and registers from previous compilation
evidence: compile appends to self.asm and retains stack_offsets/next_offset; it never resets any of the three fields.
trigger: Call compile twice on the same public X86Backend instance.
impact: The second returned assembly contains two complete headers and duplicate _start/heap labels, so it is not an independent assembly unit.

title: Explicit --files filter compares relative paths against absolute paths
evidence: git diff output is converted to relative Path objects at line 53; allowed paths are resolved at line 55; f.is_relative_to(a) compares them without resolving f.
trigger: Invoke main with --files for a changed file or directory.
impact: Changed files are filtered out and main returns success with nothing reviewed.

title: Strict reviewer stages and commits unrelated working-tree changes
evidence: After reviewing changed paths, git add . stages the complete working tree, and git commit consumes the entire index (lines 156-159).
trigger: Run reviewer in a working tree containing unrelated modified or untracked files, with the preceding stages succeeding.
impact: Unreviewed work and pre-existing staged content can be included in the automated commit.

title: Concurrent rate limiter callers reserve the same future slot
evidence: _refill resets _last_refill=now even when it was a future reservation; every deficit caller then sets tokens=0 and last_refill=clock()+wait_s.
trigger: Several threads acquire while the bucket is empty before the first waiting caller wakes.
impact: They all receive approximately the same wait and dispatch together, violating the intended rate bound and increasing upstream throttling.

title: Sensitive routing omits the explicit target from its free-model veto
evidence: candidate_list uses payload.models whenever present; build_chat_payload chooses explicit model as payload.model independently (lines 649-650); sensitive context does not imply enforce_floor at line 732.
trigger: query receives sensitive context_paths, an explicit :free model, and a paid-only models list.
impact: The pre-dispatch sensitive guard approves a payload retaining the free target. Postflight rejection happens after the prompt has already been transmitted; this defeats the local confidentiality check regardless of gateway routing outcome.

title: Preserve poisoning when the example writer is called again
evidence: write loads any seqlock value and overwrites it with seq+1 then seq+2; poison stores 0xDEAD_6060, but write never checks it.
trigger: In the standalone example, call poison(), then write(), then read().
impact: The supposedly irreversible fail-stop becomes a readable live state. The existing test only reads immediately after poison and misses this transition; no production adoption is asserted.

title: Label model arithmetic separately from physical thermodynamic evidence
evidence: bits_erased_json=1024*iterations and bits_erased_shm=0 are fixed assumptions; the harness times single-process simulated JSON formatting and local manifest calls, then prints that every thermodynamic invariant passed at line 192.
trigger: Use the PoC output as the evidence promised by its empirical falsification/thermodynamic verdict.
impact: The verdict overstates the actual checks: no physical energy measurement, real IPC transfer, or erasure accounting is performed. Restrict the conclusion to the local example and explicitly declared model assumptions.

title: Auth middleware can be skipped through the query string
evidence: Auth example checks context.request.url.includes('/public/') before verifying Authorization; context.next() forwards to the documented routes.
trigger: Use the example middleware with a request such as /api/todos/1?next=/public/.
impact: Unauthenticated requests can reach protected handlers if this reusable example is adopted. This is an example vulnerability, not evidence of a deployed service.

title: HTML error response interpolates exception text without escaping
evidence: The error middleware interpolates ${error.message} into an HTML response with text/html.
trigger: A downstream handler throws an exception whose message contains attacker-controlled HTML.
impact: The example reflects markup into the browser, enabling script injection under an applicable policy. No deployed endpoint was established.

title: Taint serialization admits distinct node contents with identical hashes
evidence: The hasher appends node.id bytes then payload bytes without lengths/separators; edges are not serialized (95–100).
trigger: Compare one-node graphs (id="a", payload=b"bc") and (id="ab", payload=b"c").
impact: Both feed identical bytes to BLAKE3 and return identical taint despite different graph contents; this is a serialization ambiguity, independent of cryptographic collision resistance.

title: Use a monotonic clock for the cooldown interval
evidence: poison records time.time() at line 33; attempt_reset subtracts time.time() at line 55 to enforce a duration. FisherBayesianEntropyGate imports and instantiates this lock and checks it before evaluation (transducers/fisher_bayesian_gate.py lines 104,125).
trigger: System wall clock advances by at least cooldown_seconds after poison, or moves backward while a reset is attempted.
impact: The public reset method may allow reset before the elapsed cooldown, or reject it excessively long. No active attempt_reset caller was found in the targeted Python search; this is a lock API defect, not a demonstrated protected-effect bypass.

title: Proposal endpoint reports postconditions VERIFIED without checking an effect
evidence: Lines 881-898 inspect only optional simulated_execution_result, and actual_file_sha256 defaults to the reported value. Lines 900-909 unconditionally emit VERIFIED, independent-verifier evidence and postconditions_checked despite effects_executed=0. cortex_mcp_server.py:1412-1418 returns this payload directly; effect_dispatch.py:56 categorizes this endpoint as read-only.
trigger: A caller proposes a validated mutation with matching caller-supplied pre-hashes and omits simulated_execution_result.
impact: MCP consumers receive false verification evidence for a proposal with no independently observed postcondition. This finding concerns returned assurance; no native execution authorization bypass is established.

title: Parser allocates the RHS name instead of the declared binding
evidence: parse_let_declaration captures the LHS identifier, but the Identifier(val) branch sets AffineAllocation.identifier to id cloned from val.
trigger: Parse let x = resource.
impact: The returned AST declares resource instead of x, so subsequent resource tracking cannot represent the source binding correctly.

title: Prove ignores source and declares compilation without invoking Lean
evidence: Source is read into _source and unused; sample_phases is fixed at183; generated theorem is constant at195-203, and211 reports compiled successfully after only fs::write.
trigger: Invoke b60 prove on any readable file, including invalid B60 input.
impact: CLI reports formal proof compilation for input it neither parses nor proves, allowing consumers to mistake emission for checked verification.

title: Example reports global regularity from hard-coded predicates
evidence: evaluate receives literal false,true,true and an empty evidence string (116-120); the selected branch prints REGULARIDAD GLOBAL CLÁSICA DEMOSTRADA (124).
trigger: Run this example and interpret its verdict as mathematical evidence.
impact: Output asserts a global PDE result without deriving its input predicates from the numerical simulation or a proof; the example overstates its evidence.

title: Voice generation reports full synchronization after synthesis errors
evidence: Nonzero synthesis status only prints stderr at 77-78; loop continues and prints 100% synchronized at 80; main returns no failure.
trigger: F5-TTS subprocess starts but fails for one or more phrases.
impact: Batch returns successful process status and full synchronization message with missing outputs.

title: Label simulated receipts as simulated, without hardware identity
evidence: trigger_biometric_gate never calls the swift_gate path. It generates an HMAC from a fixed source constant but writes status ATTESTED_BY_OPERATOR and mechanism SECURE_ENCLAVE_P256_LOCAL. execute_cycle consumes True and writes COMMITTED receipts to the demo sitrep.
trigger: Execute the supplied demo critical task.
impact: The example exports false operator/hardware attestation evidence. Only demo state and sitrep consumers were found; this is not evidence of a production authorization bypass.

title: Persistent actor resets its Lamport clock on restart
evidence: Constructor sets lamport_clock=0; _init_db only creates the table (225-241), never reads MAX(lamport_clock); commit_state computes max(local,proof.clock)+1 at 247.
trigger: Reopen a ledger containing clock 100 with a proof clock of 1.
impact: The next row can have clock 2, breaking monotonic ledger order; replaying an identical earlier proof can also collide and silently return sequence -1 (273-275).

title: Local claim provenance omits untracked source consumed by verification
evidence: source_commit excludes untracked paths at line 97; source_tree_digest enumerates only git ls-files. Current working tree has untracked semantic_solver.rs and solver_replay.rs referenced by compiler lib.rs lines 15–16. The sitrep persists these source identifiers at lines 415–416.
trigger: Run local verification while imported source files remain untracked; modify only those files between runs.
impact: Evidence can retain the same source identifiers despite different executed source bytes, weakening reproducibility and provenance for local dirty-tree runs. No runtime exploitation or release bypass is established.

title: Explicit output basename fails before exporting
evidence: os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out_path), exist_ok=True) receives an empty string for a bare filename.
trigger: Invoke --output certificate.md.
impact: CLI raises FileNotFoundError instead of writing the requested report.

title: Paper downloader disables HTTPS certificate validation globally
evidence: ssl._create_default_https_context is replaced by ssl._create_unverified_context before urlopen calls at lines 20 and 28.
trigger: Execute this script on a network where HTTPS traffic can be intercepted.
impact: Crossref metadata and downloaded paper bytes can be substituted without certificate errors; imported use also alters later urllib HTTPS behavior in that process.

title: Stress concurrency limit is private to each agent
evidence: Each stress_agent allocates asyncio.Semaphore(MAX_CONCURRENCY); run_stress_test launches500 agents at65-67.
trigger: Run the stress test expecting MAX_CONCURRENCY=50 to bound simultaneous agent work.
impact: Every task gets its own50 permits so all500 can enter; the test does not exercise or enforce its declared concurrency cap.

title: WAF score examples block clean traffic and spare the most suspicious requests
evidence: Lines 64-68 block cf.waf.score gt 50 and SQLi/XSS scores gt 30; lines 172-173 repeat the reversed comparisons. Official https://developers.cloudflare.com/waf/detections/attack-score/ documents 1 as almost certainly malicious and 99 as likely clean (retrieved 2026-10-28).
trigger: Deploy the documented custom-score rules to an applicable Cloudflare zone.
impact: Likely clean requests are blocked/challenged while scores 1-20 evade these score rules; other independent rules may still mitigate them.

title: Example formal gate approves a truthy field without checking a proof
evidence: audit_ast_closure only checks truthiness of formal_proof and claim/premise overlap, then hashes repr and returns PENDING_ATTESTATION at 77-78. The surrounding text presents it as deterministic formal closure validation.
trigger: Supply a nonempty arbitrary formal_proof string with empty claims/premises to the shown example.
impact: The documented routine accepts an unverified proof and labels it ready for attestation. Targeted consumer search found only this documentation definition; this is not a demonstrated production authorization bypass.

title: Repository remediation grants MIT rights without a license selection
evidence: When LICENSE is missing, remediate_repository schedules LICENSE_MIT_TEMPLATE, attributed to a fixed author, and --apply writes it.
trigger: Apply generic repository remediation to a repository with no LICENSE and different ownership or intended terms.
impact: The tool adds a permissive rights grant and incorrect copyright attribution without an explicit license decision.
